hero.h1: Give your time back to journalism.

core.sources: articles, press releases, public announcements, regulatory texts, studies and statistics, posts, more
core.pick: Select sources and add your own.

platform.title: One platform, two solutions
platform.sub: Two ways to work with the information.

news.name: Desk
news.body: A collaborative workspace that gathers all your sources. You can explore, filter and organise stories in real time.

signal.name: Signal
signal.body: AI agents continuously watch the flow of information for you. They reason with your context and your preferences, and deliver what matters to you. Signal integrates directly with the tools you use every day.

partners.title: We want to shape a future where journalists spend more time on
partners.lead: We are looking for newsrooms to work with us and build the future of the platform together.

finalCta.title: Upgrade your news monitoring
finalCta.sub: Desk's free demo runs on a fixed set of sources. Talk to us to add your own.

foldersView.emptyFolder: This folder is empty. Add a story from Watch via the folder icon.

notifications.subtitle: Stories you follow.

preferences.title: Reading preferences
preferences.intro: Define your editorial scope. Veilla will apply these filters by default to your Watch. Saved views ignore these preferences.

timeWindow.label: Time window
timeWindow.hint: Articles older than this are hidden from your Watch. Pick a preset or type a value in hours (1–168).

categories.label: Categories to follow
categories.hint: Empty = all categories. Pick the ones you want to see in your Watch.

articleTypes.label: Article types to follow
articleTypes.hint: Empty = all types. Pick the ones to surface (news, feature, opinion…).

places.label: Countries and regions to follow
places.hint: Empty = no geographic filter. Pick the countries or regions you want to track.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.intro: Pick the channels for each notification type. If both are off, the type is fully muted.
notifications.storyFollowIncludeArticlesHint: By default you only get update notifications (= synthesized deltas of meaningful events). Tick to also get pinged on every new article attached to a followed story.

story_follow.label: Followed stories
story_follow.hint: When a new article or update lands on a story you follow (bell button).

profile.title: Profile
profile.comingSoon: Edit your name, email, password — coming soon.

sidebar.signInToFilterUnread: Sign in to your watch to filter unread
sidebar.signInToFilterSaved: Sign in to your watch to filter saved
sidebar.signInToFilterTop: Sign in to your watch to see Top stories
sidebar.signInToViewIgnored: Sign in to your watch to view ignored
sidebar.viewTopStories: Most covered stories (sorted by number of sources)

list.noResultsWindow: No story in the current window.
list.tryAgainLater: Try again in a few minutes

period.tooltip: Time window — applies to the story list and view badges

viewDialog.description: A view is a saved set of filter criteria. Stories matching the criteria appear automatically.

folderDialog.description: A folder is a collection of stories you save together. You explicitly add stories from your Watch.
folderDialog.deleteConfirmBody: The {count, plural, =0 {stories it contains} one {1 story it contains will stay} other {# stories it contains will stay}} in your saves — only the folder disappears.
folderDialog.nameTaken: A folder with this name already exists

folderPicker.title: Add to a folder
folderPicker.empty: You don't have any folder yet

filtersDialog.title: Advanced filters
filtersDialog.description: Cumulative. Combined with AND on top of the sidebar selection.
filtersDialog.keywordsHint: Every word must appear in the story
filtersDialog.keywordsPlaceholder: e.g. interest rate, generative AI, elections…
filtersDialog.subjectCountriesHint: Countries the article is about (normalizer-tagged). Best for reliable alerts.
filtersDialog.placesHint: Free-text place mentions (cities, landmarks, sub-regions…). Noisy by extraction — use "Countries covered" above for countries.
filtersDialog.advancedFilterCount: {count, plural, one {# advanced filter} other {# advanced filters}}
filtersDialog.exclusionsHint: Articles to hide (seeded from your default preferences, editable for this session)

library.title: Bookmarks
library.emptyDescription: When you save a story from your watch, it appears here — accessible anytime, no date limit.
library.viewEmpty: No views yet — create one from Watch
library.noResultsFiltered: No save matches the active filters.
library.confirmUnsaveDescription: This story has closed — once removed from your saves, the cleanup will purge it within two weeks and you won't be able to find it again. Active stories you can always re-save from your Watch.

auth.heading: Sign in / create an account
auth.magicLinkPrompt: Enter your email. You'll receive a sign-in link.
auth.linkSentBody: Open the message sent to {email} and click the link to sign in. It expires in one hour.
auth.linkInvalid: That link has expired or was already used. Request a new one.

contact.title: Contact
contact.subtitle: We get back personally within 24 hours.
contact.successBody: We'll get back to you within 24 hours at the address you provided.
contact.errorBody: Sending failed. Try again, or write to us directly at mario@veilla.app.
contact.rateLimited: Too many requests. Try again in a few minutes.
contact.consent: By submitting this form, your information will be processed in accordance with our <link>Privacy Policy</link>.
contact.messagePlaceholder: We would like to see what Veilla could do for our use case.

prose.failed: Saving failed. Your text is kept.

logs.empty: No fetch over the last 24 hours.

agents.title: Agents
agents.intro: An agent reads the stories of your monitors and keeps the ones that answer its request, with the reason for its choice.
agents.empty: No agent yet. Create one to sort your stories.

agent.noneKept: Nothing kept over the last seven days.

config.requestHint: What the agent should keep, in plain words. It reads it with the context shared by every agent.
config.requestNote: The next decisions will follow this text; past ones stay as they are.
config.scopeHint: The stories the agent judges are those holding an article from these monitors.
config.scopeAll: All my monitors, including ones followed later

context.title: Context
context.intro: Who you are and what matters to you. Every agent receives this text with its own request: what holds for all of them is written here, once.
context.label: Reading context
context.hint: Your beat, your audience, what you count as news. A few sentences are enough.
context.note: The next decisions of every agent will follow this text.

decisions.title: Decisions
decisions.summary: {n, plural, one {# story examined} other {# stories examined}}, {kept} kept by at least one agent
decisions.search: Search a story, an article, a source…
decisions.newArticles: {n, plural, one {# new article} other {# new articles}}

panel.noAgent: No active agent reads this story.

notJudged.out_of_scope: No article of this story comes from the monitors the agent reads.
notJudged.pending: Waiting: the agent will judge it on a coming pass, or once its daily budget allows.
notJudged.budget: Daily budget reached: the story had waited over 6 hours and was not judged.

newAgent.title: New agent
newAgent.description: A name, and what it should keep. It reads all your monitors; you can narrow that on its page. It watches from now on: its first decisions come with the next articles.
newAgent.name: Name
newAgent.requestPlaceholder: Decisions that commit European industry to decarbonising: investments with figures, plants, subsidies. No op-eds.
newAgent.requestHint: In plain words. Say what you do not want, too.

budget.skipped: {n, plural, one {# story skipped} other {# stories skipped}} for lack of budget in 24 h
budget.hint: The newest stories go first; one that has waited over 6 hours is no longer judged. Narrow its monitors or sharpen its request so it judges fewer.

noAccess.noProfileHint: Ask an admin to create your profile inpublic.users(or through the admin UI), then sign in again.
